visual.general_description: A three-row table defining the findings used as Mirror Syndrome inclusion criteria.
visual.detailed_description: A black-on-white text table with two columns headed Finding and Definition, set between horizontal rules above the header, below the header and at the bottom. Rows are Placentomegaly, Fetal Hydrops and Maternal edema. Placentomegaly is defined by printed placental thickness thresholds before and after stated gestational weeks. Fetal Hydrops is defined as accumulation of fluid in two or more fetal compartments, listing ascites, pleural effusion, pericardial effusion and/or skin edema. Maternal edema is defined as based on clinical examination, listing peripheral pitting edema, sacral edema, facial edema, pulmonary edema and ascites etc, with a trailing comma. The image has no printed table number, title, footnote, photograph, anatomy, color coding or arrows.

visual.general_description: A table of fetal and neonatal outcomes of 12 infants with counts, percentages and listed etiologies.

The Neonatal death row (the label wraps over two lines) prints 3 (25) with CPAM, Twin pregnancy complicated by TRAP and co-twin demise, and Hypoplastic left heart syndrome. The Living row prints 1 (8.3) with Rh alloimmunization. Each etiology line begins with a count glyph that is the numeral 1 except one line that begins with 2. A footer defines TRAP as Twin reversed arterial perfusion sequence, TTTS as Twin to Twin transfusion syndrome, CPAM as Congenital pulmonary airway malformation and Rh as Rhesus. No photograph, anatomy, color coding or arrows are present.
